Method of Attack: Exploitation of missing quotes in executable path allowing execution of malicious files with SYSTEM permissions
Persistence and evasion by running malware through a signed service at system startup
Impacted Systems: Forcepoint VPN Client for Windows versions lower than 6.6.1
Attack Vector: Placement of malicious executable in incorrect locations ('C:\Program.exe' or 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Forcepoint\VPN.exe') exploited due to missing quotes in command line
Requires attacker to have administrator privileges on the targeted host
